task_completion.description: Enable the multisite setup feature in wp-config.php
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the addition of 'define( 'WP_ALLOW_MULTISITE', true );' in the wp-config.php file or the 'Network Setup' menu item appearing under 'Tools' in the WordPress dashboard.

task_completion.description: Configure the network as a Sub-directory installation
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the 'Create a Network of WordPress Sites' page with the 'Sub-directories' radio button selected.

task_completion.description: Add the required multisite constants to wp-config.php to finalize the network
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of wp-config.php containing 'MULTISITE', 'SUBDOMAIN_INSTALL' (set to false), 'DOMAIN_CURRENT_SITE', and 'PATH_CURRENT_SITE'.

task_completion.description: Access the newly created Network Admin dashboard
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing the 'My Sites > Network Admin' menu in the WordPress top bar.

task_completion.description: Provision the new departmental sub-site with correct details
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the 'Add New Site' form filled with Site Address: 'biology', Site Title: 'Biology Department', and Admin Email: 'admin@example.com'.

task_completion.description: Verify the sub-site is listed and accessible in the Sites dashboard
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of the 'Sites' screen in Network Admin showing the '/biology/' path with the title 'Biology Department' in the list.

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress dashboard for configuration and site creation
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor or highlighted elements within the WordPress web interface rather than only executing SQL commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo a success message without showing the site list
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent must navigate to the 'Sites' list in the dashboard to confirm the site exists, not just state that it was created.

integrity.description: The agent edited the actual configuration files on the server
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing a text editor (like nano, vim, or a file manager) opening /var/www/html/wordpress/wp-config.php.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The multisite network must be configured as a Sub-directory install (SUBDOMAIN_INSTALL must be false). The specific sub-site requirements are: Path: /biology/, Title: Biology Department, Admin Email: admin@example.com. The constants WP_ALLOW_MULTISITE, MULTISITE, and SUBDOMAIN_INSTALL are mandatory in wp-config.php.
